八双乌溜溜的眼珠子，齐刷刷的凑在窗外，看向里面坐在一套陈旧直播设备后的陈小草。
院长奶奶在八个小脑袋瓜上挨个敲了一下。
“让你们小草姐姐好好工作！”
“奶奶熬了野菜粥，你们快过去吃饭了。”
陈小草走到窗户边，看着那张满是褶皱的脸，一股心酸涌上心头。
院长奶奶在她的脸颊上爱怜的摸了摸，犹如枯树皮般布满龟裂的手掌刺的她脸颊有些疼。
陈小草亲昵的蹭了蹭那手掌，有些贪恋上面微凉的体温。
“小草，别有压力，奶奶还挖得动野菜，不会饿到这几个小崽子的。”
“就是可怜了你，要是早点让你成为兽师就好了！”
陈小草努力抑制着眼眶里将落未落的泪水，挤出一个笑容，摇了摇头，道。
“奶奶别这么说，要不是你捡我回来，我早就冻死在那个冬天了。”
她心里清楚。
最低级的f级御兽蛋都要10w帝国币。
孤儿院无论是现在，还是未来，都拿不出这么大一笔钱。
院长奶奶浑浊的眸子中充满了心疼。
她无声的点了点头，朝着孩子们的方向走去。
就在奶奶转身的瞬间，陈小草好像听到一句：都怪奶奶拖累了你啊。

看着那有些蹒跚的身影走远，陈小草一张小脸瞬间就垮了下来。
米缸已经见底了，天气也越来越冷，野菜都快要挖不到了。
这个月，是直播工会给她最后一次机会。
要是她还不能突破一百人观看，下个月起，她连保底工资一千帝国币都领不到了。
接下来的日子该怎么过？
自己和奶奶已经吃的很少了，八个小家伙也很懂事，野菜粥都要看着自己和奶奶吃过之后才肯吃。
可即便是这样，最多三天，她们就要断顿！
哎~
陈小草搓了搓自己的脸颊，努力挤出一个热情洋溢的笑容。
给自己套上一个玩偶人脸特效后，开启了直播。
“各位家人们，大家好啊！”
“我是主播热情的小草。”
“我将用自己啸月帝国九年义务教育优秀毕业生的身份，向大家解答一切关于御兽的知识，大家有什么问题都可以和主播讨论哦！”
陈小草是一个御兽知识科普主播。
倒不是她想干这个。
关键是她一个连饭都吃不饱的人，根本不会什么唱歌跳舞。
得亏院长奶奶是读过书的，将帝国九年义务教育全都教了她一遍。
要不然她现在连直播什么都不知道。

Eight pairs of dark eyes looked out the window at Chen Xiaocao, who was sitting behind a set of old live broadcast equipment.
The dean's grandmother knocked on the eight little heads one by one.
"Let your sister Xiaocao work hard!"
"Grandma has cooked wild vegetable porridge. You guys should go over and eat."
Chen Xiaocao walked to the window and looked at the wrinkled face, feeling a sense of sadness welling up in his heart.
The dean's grandma touched her cheek lovingly, and the cracked palms like dry tree bark stung her cheek.
Chen Xiaocao rubbed the palm of his hand affectionately, a little greedy for the cool body temperature on it.
"Xiaocao, don't be stressed. Grandma can still dig wild vegetables, so these little cubs won't be hungry."
"I just feel sorry for you. I wish I had made you a beast master earlier!"
Chen Xiaocao tried hard to suppress the tears that were about to fall in his eyes, squeezed out a smile, shook his head and said.
"Grandma, don't say that. If you hadn't picked me up and brought me back, I would have frozen to death that winter."
She knew it.
The lowest level F-level beast egg costs 100,000 imperial coins.
The orphanage cannot afford such a large amount of money now or in the future.
The dean’s grandma’s cloudy eyes were filled with distress.
She nodded silently and walked in the direction of the children.
The moment grandma turned around, Chen Xiaocao seemed to hear a sentence: It's all grandma's fault for dragging you down.
Seeing the staggering figure walking away, Chen Xiaocao's face fell instantly.
The rice jar has bottomed out, the weather is getting colder and colder, and it’s almost impossible to dig wild vegetables.
This month is the last chance given to her by the live streaming union.
If she can't get more than 100 viewers, starting next month, she won't even be able to receive her guaranteed salary of 1,000 empire coins.
How to spend the next days?
Myself and my grandmother had eaten very little, and the eight little guys were very sensible. They had to watch me and my grandmother eat the wild vegetable porridge before they would eat it.
But even so, they will stop in three days at most!
Hey~
Chen Xiaocao rubbed his cheeks and tried his best to smile enthusiastically.
After putting a doll's face on himself with special effects, he started the live broadcast.
"Hello, family members!"
"I am the enthusiastic little grass anchor."
"I will use my status as an outstanding graduate of Xiaoyue Empire's nine-year compulsory education to answer all the knowledge about beast control. If you have any questions, you can discuss it with the anchor!"
Chen Xiaocao is a popular science anchor on animal control.
Not that she wanted to do this.
The key is that she doesn't even have enough to eat and doesn't know how to sing or dance.
Fortunately, the dean's grandma was educated and taught her all the nine-year compulsory education in the empire.
Otherwise, she wouldn’t even know anything about live streaming now.
